name: Curse of Melancholy
body:
School necromancy [curse, despair, emotion, mind-affecting]; Level antipaladin 3, bloodrager 4, cleric/oracle 3, lathspell 3, shaman 3, sorcerer/wizard 4, spiritualist 3, witch 3

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range touch
Target creature touched
Duration permanent
Saving Throw Will negates; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

This spell inflicts a curse upon the target where everything seems impossible and hope is all but lost.

While under the effects of this curse, the target does not benefit from any morale bonus and they are subject to the doubting condition. Additionally, the save penalty the target suffers from the doubting condition is increased to -4 vs. fear and despair effects.

The curse bestowed by this spell cannot be dispelled, but it can be removed with a break enchantment, limited wish, miracle, remove curse, or wish spell.

Curse of melancholy can counter remove curse.
